    <!-- Reusable Major Hour Tick (12, 3, 6, 9) -->

    <!-- 5-Minute Tick Group (1 Hour + 4 Minutes) -->
    <g id="five-min-group">
      <use href="#hour-tick" />
      <use href="#min-tick" transform="rotate(6 200 200)" />
      <use href="#min-tick" transform="rotate(12 200 200)" />
      <use href="#min-tick" transform="rotate(18 200 200)" />
      <use href="#min-tick" transform="rotate(24 200 200)" />
    </g>

    <!-- Quadrant Tick Group (15 Minutes) -->
    <g id="quadrant-ticks">
      <use href="#five-min-group" transform="rotate(0 200 200)" />
      <use href="#five-min-group" transform="rotate(30 200 200)" />
      <use href="#five-min-group" transform="rotate(60 200 200)" />
      <!-- Cover the standard hour tick at 0 deg with a major tick -->
      <use href="#major-tick" />
    </g>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .clock-number {
      font-family: 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 700;

      fill: #7b8591;
      text-anchor: middle;
    }
    .sub-text {
      font-family: 'Montserrat', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      fill: #9aa3ae;
      text-anchor: middle;

  </style>

  <!-- 1. Outer Frame & Shadows -->
  <g filter="url(#clock-shadow)">
    <!-- Main Casing -->
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="190" fill="url(#frame-gradient)" />
    <!-- Inner Bevel -->
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="172" fill="url(#bevel-gradient)" />
  </g>

  <!-- 2. Clock Face / Dial -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="168" fill="url(#face-gradient)" />
  
  <!-- Subtle inner track for minutes -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="164" fill="none" stroke="#e2e6ec" stroke-width="0.5" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="156" fill="none" stroke="#e2e6ec" stroke-width="0.5" />

  <!-- 3. Ticks (4 Quadrants) -->
  <use href="#quadrant-ticks" transform="rotate(0 200 200)" />

  <use href="#quadrant-ticks" transform="rotate(180 200 200)" />
  <use href="#quadrant-ticks" transform="rotate(270 200 200)" />

  <!-- 4. Branding -->
  <text x="200" y="128" class="brand-text">CHRONO</text>

  <text x="200" y="285" class="sub-text">QUARTZ</text>

  <!-- 5. Numbers (Trigonometrically placed at radius 122) -->
  <g>
    <text x="200" y="78" class="clock-number major-number">12</text>
    <text x="261" y="94.3" class="clock-number">1</text>
    <text x="305.7" y="139" class="clock-number">2</text>

    <text x="305.7" y="261" class="clock-number">4</text>
    <text x="261" y="305.7" class="clock-number">5</text>
    <text x="200" y="322" class="clock-number major-number">6</text>
    <text x="139" y="305.7" class="clock-number">7</text>
    <text x="94.3" y="261" class="clock-number">8</text>
    <text x="78" y="200" class="clock-number major-number">9</text>

  <!-- 6. Recessed Dial Shadow (gives depth before hands are drawn) -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="168" fill="url(#dial-shadow)" pointer-events="none" />

  <!-- 7. Clock Hands (Time: 3:45:00) -->
  <!-- 
    Hour Hand Calculation: 
    3 hours = 90 deg. 
    45 mins = 45/60 * 30 deg = 22.5 deg. 
    Total = 112.5 deg.
  -->
  <g filter="url(#hand-shadow)" transform="rotate(112.5 200 200)">
    <!-- Main body of hour hand -->
    <path d="M 193 225 L 195 105 L 200 90 L 205 105 L 207 225 Z" fill="#242b33" />

    <line x1="200" y1="110" x2="200" y2="175" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9" />
  </g>

  <!-- 
    Minute Hand Calculation: 
    45 mins = 270 deg.
  -->
  <g filter="url(#hand-shadow)" transform="rotate(270 200 200)">

    <path d="M 194 235 L 196.5 55 L 200 42 L 203.5 55 L 206 235 Z" fill="#242b33" />

  <g filter="url(#hand-shadow)" transform="rotate(0 200 200)">

    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="2" fill="#e5e5e5" />
  </g>

  <!-- 8. Glass Reflection Overlay -->
  <path d="M 32 200 A 168 168 0 0 1 368 200 A 168 150 0 0 0 32 200 Z" fill="url(#glass-reflection)" transform="rotate(-30 200 200)" pointer-events="none" />
  
  <!-- Final inner rim highlight -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="168" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4" pointer-events="none" />
